# faBolus — LLM guide

> An iPhone app that owns a Tandem t:slim X2's Bluetooth link (through sibling `TandemKit`), with
> widgets, a Live Activity, and a Garmin watch remote (sibling `faBolusGarmin`) that asks the phone to
> act. The phone checks every remote request through the same dose path as its own bolus screen.
> Experimental, not a medical device, not FDA-cleared.

## Start with
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): layout, safety, gates, gotchas.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): the packages and the dose path.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): gates, tests, the contract workflow.
- [BRANCHES.md](BRANCHES.md): `main` and the tags.
- [docs/UNVERIFIED-GUESSES.md](docs/UNVERIFIED-GUESSES.md): pump and CGM behavior not yet confirmed.
- [docs/glossary.md](docs/glossary.md): terms.

## The dose path
`DoseComposer` (with `AccessPolicy`) → the durable bolus ledger → `PumpSession` → TandemKit's per-call
write grant (`send(_:allowing:)`) → a signed message, byte-verified against the pumpX2 oracle.

## Layout
- `Packages/faBolusCore/`: `PumpState`, `Observed<T>`, `PumpModel`/`PumpCapabilities`, `BolusOutcome`,
  `DurableBolusLedger`, `DoseComposer`, `AccessPolicy`, `GlucoseArbiter`, `PumpAlert`.
- `Packages/PumpSession/`: the pump's one owner; `PumpScript` is the scripted pump.
- `Packages/Alerts/`: the notification pipeline.
- `Packages/GlucoseSources/`, `Packages/DexcomBLE/`, `Packages/ShareClient/`: backup CGM.
- `Packages/RemoteProtocol/`: protocol v2; `contract/` holds the schema, golden fixtures and calculator rows.
- `Packages/WatchLink/`: `WatchLink` (state machine), `RemoteHost`, `GarminTransport`.
- `Packages/PhoneApp/`: `AppModel`, `AppSettings`, `BolusFlow`, `WidgetContent`.
- `Packages/HistoryStore/`, `Packages/faBolusDesign/`.
- `ios/`: SwiftUI views, the widget extension, snapshot tests.

## Commands
- All gates: `./scripts/check.sh` (or name gates: `build test app format swiftlint shell actions markdown contract`)
- One package: `swift test --package-path Packages/<name>`
- App project: `./scripts/generate-project.sh`; simulator build: `./scripts/build-sim.sh`
- Rewrite golden fixtures: `UPDATE_CONTRACT=1 swift test --package-path Packages/RemoteProtocol`

## Conventions
Match surrounding style. Don't invent pump behavior; unverified fields go in
`docs/UNVERIFIED-GUESSES.md`.
